about: Preregistered criteria for run 2 of benchmarks/serve (serve decisions beside a local LLM). Written after run 1 (m4-max) and before any run-2 data; not changed after run-2 data is seen. Only the V2 and V4 validity definitions differ from criteria.json; every result criterion (G1, G2, L1, L2, C1, E1) and V1, V3, V5 are unchanged. Definitions in README.md (Run 2); analyze.py implements them.

G1_llm_cost_auto.metric: 1 - median(tok/s, auto decisions_llm windows) / median(tok/s, llm_alone windows)

G2_auto_below_gpu_only.metric: drop(gpu) - drop(auto), where drop(c) = 1 - median(tok/s, c decisions_llm) / median(tok/s, llm_alone)
G2_auto_below_gpu_only.must_exceed: llm_alone_noise = (max - min) / median of tok/s over llm_alone windows

L1_short_p99_loaded_abs_ms.metric: median over auto decisions_llm windows of the per-window short_1q P99, from scheduled arrival to response

L2_short_p99_loaded_vs_unloaded.metric: L1's value / the same statistic over auto decisions windows

C1_fp16_gate.metric: every decision in every decisions / decisions_llm window of both configs, against the same serve process's unloaded reference

E1_errors.metric: requests without an HTTP 200 answer (status, timeout or connection error), every decision window of both configs

V1_open_loop_client_lag_p99_ms.metric: P99 of sent - scheduled, per decision window

V2_llm_saturated.metric: per LLM window: fraction of the window during which at least one of this harness's LLM requests was in flight at the server, each request from its start_ns to its last chunk (prefill included)
V2_llm_saturated.reported_not_gated: generating_coverage: fraction of the window during which tokens were streaming (run 1's V2 metric)

V3_llm_exclusive.metric: the LLM server was idle at window start, and its total_requests grew by exactly this harness's own request count across the window

V4_auto_short_policy_path.metric: short_1q answers routed by the product policy's short path, per auto window: device ane, or device gpu with reason ane_backlog_shorter_on_gpu; any other reason on the gpu counts against it
V4_auto_short_policy_path.reported_not_gated: spill share: short_1q answers on the gpu with reason ane_backlog_shorter_on_gpu, per auto window
V4_auto_short_policy_path.note: L1 and L2 include the spilled requests

V5_references_on_expected_devices.metric: auto: short_1q references on ane, mixed_3q on gpu; gpu: all on gpu

notes: Throughput, latency and correctness are separate results; there is no overall PASS/FAIL.
A validity failure makes the affected result invalid (neither pass nor fail); rerun as a new campaign directory.
GPU-only (serve --device gpu) is measured with the same metrics and has no threshold: it is the comparison.
Run 1 (m4-max) is analyzed with criteria.json only; it was invalid on V2 and V4 and is not re-analyzed under these criteria.
